title: Renal Transporters After Renal Transplantation
brief_summary: Previous studies in animals revealed, that the activity of certain transporters along the nephron is changed with acute rejection after renal transplantation. We intend to investigate underlying mechanisms occurring in man in renal biopsy specimens obtained from patients because of acute rejection of the transplant or chronic transplant nephropathy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* individuals transplanted with a donor kidney
* individuals with acute transplant rejection

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy
* malignant disease
* HIV infection
